fato_historico: 1992: China Southern Airlines Flight 3943 crashes on approach to Guilin Qifengling Airport in Guilin, China, killing all 141 people on board.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reflect on the fragility and beauty of life today. Just as birds navigate the winds, you may find your path shifting unexpectedly. It is a good time to cherish deep connections and practice gratitude. Perhaps consider how your resilience turns every challenge into a soft landing for your soul's growth.
frase_do_dia: Find the courage to rise above the clouds and embrace your true light.
significado_numero: Represents the balance between emotional depth and practical change.
conselho: Trust your intuition and nurture your spirit with small acts of kindness today.
